about: Radio and intercom for the launch chapter. t = seconds from liftoff. Original lines in the style of Apollo launch procedure; not quotes of real people. The player is the Commander and does not speak: the Command Module Pilot (CMP) and Lunar Module Pilot (LMP) make the callouts. Speakers: LC launch control (public affairs loop), STC spacecraft test conductor (pad loop), CAPCOM (Houston, with Quindar tones), CMP and LMP (intercom).

lines.text: This is Apollo-Saturn Launch Control. T minus three minutes, thirty seconds and counting. All elements are go for the terminal count.
Apollo, this is the spacecraft test conductor. Final status check. Give me a go when your board is ready.
Board looks good, STC. We are go up here.
T minus three minutes. The firing command is coming in now. From here on, the count is on the automatic sequencer.
Apollo, confirm launch escape motor armed, and the abort handle in neutral.
Escape motor armed. Abort handle neutral.
T minus two minutes thirty. The first stage fuel tanks are now pressurizing. The vents are closing.
You can hear it. The whole stack is coming alive under us.
T minus two minutes. The crew are strapped in, visors down. The spacecraft is on internal power.
Apollo, STC. Oxygen flow is good, cabin pressure good. Have a good flight, gentlemen.
Thank you, STC. See you in a couple of weeks.
T minus ninety seconds. Third stage tanks pressurizing.
Fuel cells look good. Main bus voltages twenty eight point two.
T minus sixty seconds. All stages now show pressurized.
T minus fifty. Power transfer is complete. The launch vehicle is on internal power.
T minus forty seconds. All still go.
Thirty seconds.
Here we go.
T minus seventeen. Guidance is internal.
Fifteen.
fourteen.
thirteen.
twelve.
eleven.
ten.
Ignition sequence start.
six.
five.
four.
three.
two.
one.
zero.
All engines running.
Liftoff. We have liftoff.
Tower clear.
Roger, clear of the tower. Houston has it.
Roll and pitch program.
Roger, roll and pitch.
Roll complete.
Apollo, Houston. Thrust is go, all engines. You are looking good.
Through Mach one.
Through max Q. Mode one Charlie.
Apollo, Houston. You are go for staging.
Inboard out.
Staging.
And we have ignition. Five good engines on the second stage.
Apollo, Houston. Skirt separation is confirmed. Go for tower jettison.
Tower jettison.
There it is. Look at that horizon.
The sky is going black already.
Apollo, Houston. You are go at four minutes. Mode two.
Go at five minutes. All systems nominal.
Cabin pressure holding at five point one.
Apollo, Houston. You are go at seven minutes. Third stage to orbit capability.
Center engine out on the second stage.
Second stage shutdown. Staging.
Third stage ignition. Smooth as silk.
Apollo, Houston. You are go at ten minutes. Everything looks great from here.
Shutdown.
Roger, shutdown. Apollo, we have you in a ninety by ninety orbit. Welcome to space.
Would you look at that. Clouds and ocean all the way to the horizon.
Your spacecraft, Commander.
